headline: Jensen Huang resigns as *Nvidia CEO*
sub: CFO Colette Kress named interim chief as the board begins a search for a permanent successor
caption: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO after 33 years. CFO Colette Kress is now interim chief while the board searches for a permanent successor. Shares fell as much as 13% intraday.

linkedin.hook: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO, effective immediately, after leading the company he co-founded for 33 years.
points: CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and keeps her CFO role
Former Synopsys CEO Harvey C. Jones is Nvidia's first board chair
Shares fell as much as 13% intraday and closed more than 4% lower
linkedin.close: All eyes now turn to Nvidia's Q3 results on November 17.
